servers.name: weather-open-meteo
servers.description: Comprehensive Open-Meteo MCP server for forecasting, archives, air quality, marine conditions, flood outlooks, ensembles, seasonal outlooks, and climate projections.

tools.name: geocoding
tools.description: Resolve place names into latitude, longitude, timezone, and country metadata.

tools.name: weather_forecast
tools.description: Get forecast and recent-history weather time series with hourly, daily, and current variables.

tools.name: weather_archive
tools.description: Query archived historical weather back to 1940 using ERA5-backed data.

tools.name: air_quality
tools.description: Inspect PM2.5, PM10, ozone, nitrogen dioxide, pollen, AQI indices, UV, and related air-quality indicators.

tools.name: marine_weather
tools.description: Retrieve marine weather, wave, swell, sea-surface temperature, and ocean-current variables.

tools.name: flood_forecast
tools.description: Inspect GloFAS river discharge and flood forecast signals for up to 210 days.

tools.name: elevation
tools.description: Get elevation for a coordinate pair.

tools.name: ecmwf_forecast
tools.description: Run ECMWF model forecasts for high-quality global outlooks.

tools.name: gfs_forecast
tools.description: Run NOAA GFS forecasts for global and North America-focused weather analysis.

tools.name: dwd_icon_forecast
tools.description: Run DWD ICON forecasts for Europe-focused high-resolution weather analysis.

tools.name: meteofrance_forecast
tools.description: Run Météo-France forecasts for France and nearby regional coverage.

tools.name: jma_forecast
tools.description: Run JMA forecasts for Asia-Pacific weather analysis.

tools.name: metno_forecast
tools.description: Run MET Norway forecasts for Nordic and blended regional analyses.

tools.name: gem_forecast
tools.description: Run Environment Canada GEM forecasts for Canada and North America.

tools.name: ensemble_forecast
tools.description: Inspect forecast uncertainty using ensemble-member weather outputs.

tools.name: seasonal_forecast
tools.description: Retrieve 1-9 month seasonal outlooks.

tools.name: climate_projection
tools.description: Query CMIP6-style climate projections for scenario-based long-term analysis.

servers.name: nasa
servers.description: NASA MCP server for Earth observation, hazard, wildfire, imagery, and POWER climate/energy data.

tools.name: nasa/power
tools.description: Query NASA POWER environmental and climate variables.

tools.name: nasa/eonet
tools.description: Track natural events through NASA EONET.

tools.name: nasa/firms
tools.description: Inspect wildfire and thermal anomaly signals from FIRMS.

tools.name: nasa/gibs
tools.description: Retrieve Earth imagery layers from GIBS.

tools.name: nasa/cmr
tools.description: Search Earth science collections and granules in CMR.

servers.name: eosc-data-commons
servers.description: EOSC Data Commons dataset-discovery MCP server for searching open-access research datasets and dataset file metadata.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search open-access datasets relevant to a research question.

tools.name: get_dataset_file_metadata
tools.description: Inspect file-level metadata for a selected dataset.
